text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S and her Trainer watch a TV 
show naming Tanino Gimlet as the top 
favorite to win the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ran remarkably well in both the 
Satsuki Sho and the NHK Mile Cup. That 
grueling rotation has become the talk of 
the town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was said that if Tanino Gimlet won the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), it would 
prove her ability to dominate at both mile 
and intermediate distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The depths of that "potential" were still 
unfathomable— The Trainer felt a twinge of 
anxiety about Symboli Kris S facing her in 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), which would decide the top of the 
generation, was just around the corner.
